stages.prompt: We're building a help center. Set up HelpArticle records with slug, title and body, all text. Slugs must be unique. Our articles are in English, and people need to find them by words in the title or body, best matches first.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type HelpArticle { slug: String @index(ordered: {unique:true}) title: String @fulltext(language:"english") body: String @fulltext(language:"english") }

stages.prompt: Load the articles in help_articles.json. Then search for "refund invoice" and tell me the slug of the best match.
